verdict.rationale: Published plan pricing is a fair question for a commercial design-editor SaaS like Rive, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party pricing page documenting seat types, tiers, or AI-feature gating. The only price signal is a community comment recalling $25/$39 per month, which is not published plan documentation.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement
